_meta.notes: NO interim / year-end / final box is checked on this form - only the amendment 'Yes' box, and the 'date of report' blank next to it was left EMPTY, so report_type is an honest empty string (the clerk listing calls it 'Amendment to April'). contributions.detail: exact (2000 = 2000); the single Schedule A row carries the whole stated total

expenditures.detail: The Schedule B page EXISTS but is entirely unfilled - no rows, no subtotal, no total, and even the Page / Last Name / Date of Report header box is blank - while the Summary Page states 483.51 (Line 2 and Line 6 both). There is nothing on the page to transcribe, so ZERO rows are emitted and NO itemized sum is claimed: writing 0.00 here would assert the candidate spent nothing, which the form itself contradicts. This is an unfiled itemization, not a zero.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 (Sch A): the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells are both left EMPTY by the filer, so no gate can fire on the page; the single row's 2,000 matches the Summary Page's stated 2000. p4 (Sch B): blank page, no printed subtotal - no gate possible.
